Serialization support has been implemented for [`ShapeIndex`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-_jaybeef/s2/shapeindex.go) in a new branch `shapeindex-serialization` branched from `main`.

### Summary of Changes

1. **[`ShapeIndex.Encode`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-_jaybeef/s2/shapeindex_coding.go#L110) & [`ShapeIndex.Decode`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-_jaybeef/s2/shapeindex_coding.go#L190)**:
   - Added `Encode(w io.Writer) error` and `Decode(r io.Reader) error` on `*ShapeIndex`.
   - Before encoding, `maybeApplyUpdates()` is invoked so any pending updates are incorporated into the spatial cell structure.
   - Header metadata (`encodingVersion`, `maxEdgesPerCell`, `nextID`, `numShapes`) is encoded, ensuring even an empty `ShapeIndex` serializes to a non-empty byte stream.
   - All spatial cells (`cells` and `cellMap`) along with their [`clippedShape`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-_jaybeef/s2/shapeindex.go#L73) mappings are preserved so queries (`LocatePoint`, `LocateCellID`, `ContainsPointQuery`, `CrossingEdgeQuery`) and iterators work immediately without requiring `Build()`.
   - Shape IDs are preserved to keep cell references valid even after shape additions and removals.

2. **Built-in [`Shape`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-_jaybeef/s2/shape.go#L184) Types Round-Trip Support**:
   - Added `Encode` and `Decode` methods and `typeTag` constants to support all built-in types:
     - [`Polygon`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-_jaybeef/s2/polygon.go) (`typeTagPolygon = 1`)
     - [`Polyline`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-_jaybeef/s2/polyline.go) (`typeTagPolyline = 2`)
     - [`PointVector`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-_jaybeef/s2/point_vector.go) (`typeTagPointVector = 3`)
     - [`LaxPolyline`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-_jaybeef/s2/lax_polyline.go) (`typeTagLaxPolyline = 4`)
     - [`LaxPolygon`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-_jaybeef/s2/lax_polygon.go) (`typeTagLaxPolygon = 5`)
     - [`Loop`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-_jaybeef/s2/loop.go) (`typeTagLoop = 6`)
     - [`LaxLoop`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-_jaybeef/s2/lax_loop.go) (`typeTagLaxLoop = 7`)
   - Supported zero-edge shapes (empty geometries as well as full polygons) and mixed chain counts.

3. **Robust Input Validation & Error Handling**:
   - Guarded allocations against oversized requests across all decoders by enforcing maximum element thresholds and chunked slice allocations.
   - Checked for truncated data, corrupted headers, out-of-order cell/edge IDs, invalid cell IDs, and dimension mismatches.
   - Wrapped deserialization in panic recovery to ensure malformed input returns errors instead of panicking.

4. **Testing**:
   - Added test suite in [`s2/shapeindex_coding_test.go`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-_jaybeef/s2/shapeindex_coding_test.go) verifying round-trip encoding/decoding of all shape types, zero-edge shapes, mixed chain counts, unbuilt indices, ID preservation after removals, and corrupted/oversized/truncated inputs. All tests pass with `-race`.

Binary serialization for [`s2.ShapeIndex`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-_jaybeef/s2/shapeindex.go) has been implemented and committed to branch [`shapeindex-serialization`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-_jaybeef).

### Changes Implemented
- **Serialization on [`ShapeIndex`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-_jaybeef/s2/shapeindex_coding.go):**
  - Added [`Encode(w io.Writer) error`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-_jaybeef/s2/shapeindex_coding.go#L62) and [`Decode(r io.Reader) error`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-_jaybeef/s2/shapeindex_coding.go#L182).
  - Explicitly invokes `maybeApplyUpdates()` prior to encoding so unbuilt indexes serialize their complete cell index.
  - An empty index serializes a valid binary header and counts to a non-empty byte stream.
  - Full spatial cell structure (`cells`, `cellMap`, `clippedShape` references, `containsCenter`, and edge lists) is serialized and restored with status `fresh`, enabling immediate spatial queries and iteration without calling `Build()`.
  - Shape IDs and `nextID` are preserved across removals, maintaining valid references from spatial cells.

- **Built-in Shape Encoders/Decoders:**
  - Added round-trip encoding/decoding and type tags for all 7 built-in shape types:
    - [`PointVector`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-_jaybeef/s2/point_vector.go) (`typeTagPointVector = 3`)
    - [`LaxPolyline`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-_jaybeef/s2/lax_polyline.go) (`typeTagLaxPolyline = 4`)
    - [`LaxPolygon`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-_jaybeef/s2/lax_polygon.go) (`typeTagLaxPolygon = 5`)
    - [`Loop`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-_jaybeef/s2/loop.go) (`typeTagLoop = 6`)
    - [`LaxLoop`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-_jaybeef/s2/lax_loop.go) (`typeTagLaxLoop = 7`)
    - [`Polyline`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-_jaybeef/s2/polyline.go) (`typeTagPolyline = 2`)
    - [`Polygon`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-_jaybeef/s2/polygon.go) (`typeTagPolygon = 1`)
  - Supports zero-edge shapes (empty geometries and full polygons) as well as multi-chain shapes.

- **Security & Malformed Input Protection:**
  - Enforced bounds (`maxEncodedShapes`, `maxEncodedCells`, `maxEncodedClippedShapes`, `maxEncodedEdges`, `maxShapePayloadLen`).
  - Guarded allocations with chunked streaming payload readers (`readPayload`) and capped slice allocations (`min(count, 1024)`) to reject truncated streams without upfront memory exhaustion.
  - Added panic recovery and error propagation across decoding.
  - Hardened existing `decode` methods in [`Polygon`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-_jaybeef/s2/polygon.go), [`Polyline`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-_jaybeef/s2/polyline.go), and [`Loop`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-_jaybeef/s2/loop.go) against out-of-memory crashes on malformed counts.

- **Index Updates & Deadlock Fixes in [`s2/shapeindex.go`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-_jaybeef/s2/shapeindex.go):**
  - Resolved recursive mutex locking in `updateEdges` by using an unmanaged iterator.
  - Implemented `tracker.lowerBound` using binary search to support incremental cell updates during shape removals.
  - Corrected sentinel shape ID collisions in `makeIndexCell` and shape ID indexing in `applyUpdatesInternal`.

- **Comprehensive Test Suite in [`s2/shapeindex_coding_test.go`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-_jaybeef/s2/shapeindex_coding_test.go):**
  - Covers empty index, all built-in types, mixed shapes, shape ID preservation with removals, unbuilt index encoding, zero-edge/full shapes, mixed chain counts, fuzzing, corrupted headers, truncated data, and oversized allocation requests. All pass cleanly under `go test -race ./...`.
